name: Nekomimi Honey Life
original_name: ネコミミハニィライフ
source:
One day, the protagonist, Takaki, looks into a pet shop window and sees a catgirl for sale. He instinctively decides to buy her. Thus begins their cohabitation.

[translated from http://clunkers.be/note/index.php?e=17]
translation:
某天，主人公贵树路过宠物店时透过橱窗瞥见了一名待售的猫耳娘，鬼使神差之下当即决定将她买回家中，一人一猫娘甜蜜温馨的同居生活就此拉开序幕。

[译自http://clunkers.be/note/index.php?e=17]
